RM_ETC_SW2_Line03: Today, we'll learn to construct a simple lean-to shelter.
RM_ETC_SW2_Line04: Find a downed tree or place a sturdy branch between two supports.
RM_ETC_SW2_Line05: Lean smaller branches against it to form a frame.
